mint-action.publicRole: accent (--r-accent), focus, bubble-mine; Mint is the default theme

display-closing.purpose: The send-off line; the largest type on the page.

headline.purpose: Section statements, two short balanced lines.

headline-step.purpose: Each tour step statement; clamp(1.9rem, 7vw, 2.6rem) on phones.

title.purpose: Row titles inside a section; the profile name.

lead.purpose: The line under a headline, Ink 2, 34-36ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, room tabs, status lines (bold).

tag.purpose: Status pills, the nav column's "Your Spaces" head, the SoonTag, chat's day and "New" lines.

screen-title-hero.purpose: "Pick your colour.", sign-up step 1: 2.9rem, 3.6rem from 40rem, 4.6rem from 80rem.

card-title.purpose: The one title in an AuthCard: 2.4rem, 2.7rem from 40rem.

place-title.purpose: A destination or settings page H1 at the top of the sheet: 1.75rem, 1.9rem from 48rem, bold. Home's greeting is set the same at 2rem from 48rem.

empty-title.purpose: An empty state heading on the sheet: 1.3rem bold.

lead-app.purpose: The line under a place title, Ink 2, 60ch.

body-small.purpose: Step descriptions, notices, field errors, the way across.

hint.purpose: Field hints and status lines, small notes, the auth footer.

control-sm.purpose: Small pills, the Show switch, the birthday part labels.

caption.purpose: Second lines in lists: who is here, Travel hints, the picker note.

micro.purpose: Keyboard keys and the "New" chip on a poster.

code.purpose: The one-time code field, spaced digits.

space-title.purpose: A Space's name in its header: 1.2rem, 1.5rem from 48rem, bold.

dialog-title.purpose: A Dialog sheet's heading and a room's opening line.

row-title.purpose: A Space's name in Explore's rows.

chat-small.purpose: Names over a run, reply quotes, addresses, error lines, presence lines.

live-title.purpose: A live voice room's name on a Live tile.

shelf-title.purpose: Home's shelf heads ("Live now", "Your Spaces"); Atkinson, never Funnel.

nav-label.purpose: The nav column's destinations (1rem semibold); its Space rows and the settings list at 0.95rem.

shadows.name: moment-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating moment pills beside the tour phone.

shadows.name: header-glass
shadows.value: background: rgb(11 11 14 / 0.72); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.5); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07)
shadows.purpose: The header only: the one backdrop blur in the world.

shadows.name: card-drop
shadows.purpose: The AuthCard on the lit ground.

shadows.name: overlay-lift
shadows.purpose: Here now while it lies over the page, always with the panel scrim and the Raised fill.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: The You, Create and notifications panels.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: A focused field, with its edge in the accent. Spread only, no blur.

shadows.name: panel-scrim
shadows.purpose: Under Here now when it opens over the page; a click on it closes.

shadows.name: dialog-veil
shadows.purpose: Under Travel, and over the app sketch behind sign-in.

shadows.name: phone-chrome
shadows.value: header: rgb(11 11 14 / 0.92); tabs: rgb(11 11 14 / 0.96); no backdrop blur
shadows.purpose: The app's phone header and tabs: solid, so the app has no blur.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: A result list dropping over the page (Nearby's city search).

shadows.name: speaking-ring
shadows.purpose: A voice tile while that person talks; Ink, never the accent.

shadows.name: poster-lift
shadows.purpose: A Space poster on hover and focus, with a 4px rise. A white ring, never the accent.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Theme swap across the whole world.

motion.name: light-blend
motion.purpose: The light field moving to a new theme.

motion.name: press
motion.value: 150ms ease-out; scale(0.97) on active; brightness(1.1) on hover

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Swatch lift, holo card tilt, loader mark.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: y 36px to 0, opacity 0 to 1, 0.9s power3.out, stagger 0.08s, once

motion.name: scrub
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger on native scroll, scrub 0.6
motion.purpose: Sticky stages and the closing phone fan.

motion.name: theme-relight
motion.purpose: The re-light outside the front page (the sign-up pick, the You menu, Appearance). Off for reduced motion and Pause motion.

motion.name: ui-ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); 150ms hover and press, 200ms swatches; never over 300ms
motion.purpose: Everything the person triggers in the account and app screens.

motion.name: typing-dots
motion.value: realm-typing 1.2s ease-in-out infinite, 0.15s stagger; motion-safe only

motion.name: recording-pulse
motion.value: pulse on a 10px Danger Line dot; still under reduced motion

motion.name: speaking
motion.purpose: The speaking ring in and out.

motion.name: poster-lift
motion.value: transform and box-shadow 200ms ease-out; translateY(-4px) with motion allowed; banner scale 1.04 (posters) or 1.03 (live tiles) over 500ms
motion.purpose: Posters and Live tiles on hover.

components.name: Emoji Picker
components.description: Search, group tabs and an 8-column grid that is one tab stop with arrow keys; recent emoji first. Shared by reactions and the composer.
components.css: .ds-ep{width:19.5rem;padding:8px;border-radius:1.2rem;background:#1d1d24;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255/0.1),0 30px 70px -20px #000;font-family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible Next",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-ep input{width:100%;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:rgb(245 244 242/0.06);color:#f5f4f2;font:inherit;font-size:0.95rem;outline:none}.ds-ep input::placeholder{color:#c0bec8}.ds-ep input:focus-visible{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--r-focus,#3ee6b0)}.ds-ep-tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-top:8px}.ds-ep-tabs button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:0.6rem;background:transparent;font-size:1.05rem;opacity:0.6;cursor:pointer}.ds-ep-tabs button:hover{opacity:1;background:rgb(245 244 242/0.06)}.ds-ep-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{opacity:1;background:rgb(245 244 242/0.1)}.ds-ep-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:2px;margin-top:8px}.ds-ep-grid button{aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:0.6rem;background:transparent;font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 100ms ease-out}.ds-ep-grid button:hover,.ds-ep-grid button:focus-visible{background:rgb(245 244 242/0.08);transform:scale(1.1);outline:none}

components.name: Pinned Bar
components.description: The newest pinned message at the top of a chat on a 4% Ink strip, with an "N pinned" popover of them all.

narrative.overview:
Realm's world is a dark room lit by the colour of whoever's profile is in view. The ground is a near-black ink (the ink ground), and behind everything three soft colour fields glow, taken from the active profile theme (Mint by default; Orchid, Aqua and Ember when the theme swaps) under a fine grain. On the front page they drift as you scroll; everywhere else they hold still. The page does not decorate itself: the real app does the showing, while big tight Funnel Display headlines carry the story and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next carries every word you read.

The world has one moving idea: your colour takes over the page. The action colour, the light, the mark's inner dot, the focus ring, the selection and the 3D rim light all read from the same theme variables, and a theme change cross-fades all of them together (0.8s). On the front page those variables sit on the world root (`[data-world="canvas"]`) and follow the profile in view; on every other screen they are the person's own theme, set on `<html>` (`data-accent`), so sign-in and the app wear the colour you picked. Night is the default and only edition of this world for now; a day edition and user-made themes come later, under the paid "make it yours" theming plan in `docs/THEMING.md` (the plan lives there, not here).

It rejects the previous world (the space diorama, molten amber, aurora and nebula, astronauts and mascots floating loose as stickers), the template dark SaaS page of feature cards on black, and, inside the app, both a Discord-style server rail and the generic sidebar-plus-cards dashboard. Density is low and cinematic on the front page (one statement per viewport, the product beside it) and in the app it should feel like a real app: a labelled nav column on the lit ground beside one solid sheet, what's live with your people up front, hairlines inside, and little to press besides joining what's live. In the app the Instagram and Threads feel (faces, posters, a wall of what your people are doing) leads a little over the Discord feel (rooms, voice, who's in), which stays present; Realm clones neither (the owner, 2026-10-05).
keyCharacteristics: Ink ground lit by three theme-coloured fields plus grain; never flat black, never a starfield. Moving on the front page, still everywhere else.
One action colour per screen, and it is the person's own theme.
The real app UI, framed in black-bezel phones and rounded window frames, is the imagery.
Funnel Display set tight and huge for statements and names; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for reading.
Pills everywhere you act or read a status; generous rounded rectangles for frames and panels.
In the app: a labelled nav column on the lit ground beside one solid Surface sheet; content straight on the sheet under hairlines, never boxes in boxes.
Native scroll; scrubbed sticky stages; a full static fallback for anyone who isn't moving.

rules.name: The Worst Point Rule
rules.body: Every grey text tone must pass 4.5:1 against the light field's brightest possible point, held at relative luminance 0.075. That is why Ink 2 and Ink 3 are as light as they are, and why each theme carries a `glow` factor solved so its brightest point stays at 0.075. `tokens.test.ts` checks it for every theme. A new theme ships with its glow solved, or it doesn't ship.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: The theme colour is the person's, and it appears only on: the one action per screen (the one action pill), focus (rings and the field's focus edge), "needs you" (the "New" chip on a Space poster and the "New" line in chat: a word, never a number), the Me avatar, and your own chat bubbles (decided by the owner on 2026-10-04, and shipped: `bubble-mine` and `on-bubble-mine` follow the accent). Something live you can drop into carries Join as an action pill (the owner, 2026-10-05): each Live tile on Home and the Live strip in a room. In a room, the one action is the composer's round Send; on a voice room before you join, Join voice; in a sheet, its submit (Add this place, Send report). Everything else that acts is a ghost or quiet pill or a text link. Product previews (the sign-up profile card, the front page's frames) show it as the product wears it; they are inert art, never controls. Messages (built 2026-10) puts the accent on four things this list does not name, and the owner has not ruled on them: the count of waiting conversations on Messages in the nav column and the phone tab (a number, where this rule says a word), the unread dot on an inbox row (a Space row's unread dot is Ink), your own reaction chips (a 1.5px accent ring on a 15% accent fill), and the picked check circle in New message (a selection, which elsewhere is never the accent). Until they are ruled on, don't copy them to other surfaces.

rules.name: The Light Is The Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue enters the page as light (the field, the banner, the 3D rim light, the swatches), never as tinted panels or coloured box-shadow glows on UI.

rules.name: The Re-light Rule
rules.body: A colour change is never a snap. The accent, its "on" colour, the three lights and the glow are registered with `@property` and cross-fade over 0.8s (the in-out curve outside the front page, `ease` on it), and stop for reduced motion and Pause motion.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Funnel Display is for statements and names only: one title per screen, plus place, section and panel names, profile names and initials. Anything a person reads for meaning is Atkinson, including every label, hint, error and link. Never set body copy in Funnel, never set a headline in Atkinson. Inside the app it is bold, at product sizes (1.2–2rem), and reserved for greetings, page titles and Space or room names (the owner, 2026-10-05); the settings section, empty-state, Here now and dialog headings still set in it predate that ruling.

rules.name: The One Title Rule
rules.body: Each screen has one Funnel title, and it is the H1. Settings pages take their own name as the H1 (the settings list beside it already says "Settings").

rules.name: The Said After Rule
rules.body: A step's status ("First in early access", "Coming soon") is a bold line with a dot after its text, or a tag at the row's end, never a pill or eyebrow stamped above the heading.

rules.name: The Black Shadows Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, long and soft, offset straight down. No coloured glow shadows, no hard offsets. The one coloured ring is focus: a field's 4px accent halo at 22%, spread only, no blur.

rules.name: The Lifted Overlay Rule
rules.body: A panel that opens over the page always gets all three: the scrim, the Raised fill with the 12% ring, and the overlay shadow, so it reads as lifted over the page, not as the page cut short.

rules.name: The One Blur Rule
rules.body: At most one small backdrop blur per screen, and the header owns it: the front page's ink glass (72% ink ground, blur-xl, saturate 150%). The app has none: its phone header is solid ink ground at 92% and its phone tabs at 96%. Nothing else blurs what's behind it; menus, popovers, dialogs, the sheet and Here now are solid.

rules.name: The Outside The Bubble Rule
rules.body: Photos and videos stand on their own beside the words, at their own ratio, with the Media corner; they never sit on a coloured mat inside a bubble. Files, voice notes and places are the bubble's own content, with no card inside it.

rules.name: The Outline Danger Rule
rules.body: A destructive action is a ghost pill with Danger text and a 1.5px Danger Line ring, or a Danger row in a menu. Danger never fills a button.

rules.name: The Honest Control Rule
rules.body: Never offer a control that can't do anything. When a service isn't configured, say so plainly ("Voice calls aren't set up on this Realm yet.", "Push notifications aren't set up on this Realm yet.", "Maps aren't set up on this Realm yet.") and hide the control, or label it Coming soon.

rules.name: The Short Line Rule
rules.body: A live region speaks one short status line: the newest message from someone else, "Recording started", the pick, the result count. Never a whole list, never history as it loads.

dos: Do read colours through the role names (`bg-surface`, `text-fg-soft`, `bg-accent`, `--r-*`) outside the front page, and through `--acc`, `--on-acc`, `--l1`–`--l3` on the front page's world root, so a theme change moves the whole screen at once.
Do check any new grey against luminance 0.075 at 4.5:1, and solve a `glow` for any new theme.
Do keep the theme colour to the one action per screen, Join on live tiles and the Live strip, focus, "needs you" ("New"), the Me avatar and your own chat bubbles.
Do put tags and chips on dark pills (60% ink ground with a hairline ring).
Do show the real app inside phone or window frames, or as a still sketch, instead of illustrating it.
Do say status after a step's text, with a dot, or as a tag at the row's end: "First in early access" in the action colour, "Coming soon" in Ink 2.
Do label everything not built yet "Coming soon" plainly (SoonTag, Create's list), and say what will go there.
Do say plainly that direct messages are not end-to-end encrypted yet, wherever DMs are offered or described, and call a community a "Space".
Do put content straight on the sheet, divided by hairlines: empty states, settings sections, Home's shelves.
Do give anything that opens over the page the scrim, the Raised fill, the 12% ring and the overlay shadow, and close it on Escape and a click outside, with focus moved in and back.
Do list Spaces by name in the nav column, with their badge, a speaker while someone's in voice and a dot when something's new.
Do keep navigation labelled at every width: the nav column's rows always carry their names, and the phone tabs their labels.
Do hold the app's content in one Surface sheet beside the nav column, with the nav and the lit ground around it.
Do set display type only for greetings, page titles and Space or room names, bold, at product sizes (1.2–2rem).
Do show only real live things on Home: real faces, rooms with people in them right now, your actual Spaces; unread is the word "New".
Do let the Instagram and Threads feel (faces, posters, live tiles) lead a little over the Discord feel, and keep Discord's live parts (voice rooms, who's in, Join) present.
Do ship a plain static sequence for reduced motion, Pause motion and no WebGL, decided in CSS before first paint.
Do keep the 3D phone rendering only while on screen, turning through its edge, with moments beside it.
Do let photos and videos stand outside the bubble at their own ratio, and keep files, voice notes and places inside it as plain content.
Do make every destructive action an outline: a ghost pill with Danger text and a 1.5px Danger Line ring, or a Danger menu row in its own group.
Do say plainly when something isn't set up ("Voice calls aren't set up on this Realm yet.") or label it "Coming soon", and hide the control that can't work.
Do send a person's position in a request body, for one search, rounded, and say so where it's asked for.
Do keep a live region to one short status line, and keep empty live regions in place without taking room (`empty:absolute`).
Do put the room you're in into view in the room tabs, on their own row under the Space's name.
Do show the current tab, room, sort or reason as a neutral raised pill or an Ink ring, never in the accent.
Do set Messages as the inbox beside the conversation from 64rem (the inbox 22rem, 23.5rem from 80rem, a hairline on its right), and let them take turns below that.
Do label every DM and group chat with the quiet "Not end-to-end encrypted yet" chip (a dark pill in Ink 2) that opens the explainer, and say it again in the Conversation start.
Do offer the quick six reactions (❤️ 😂 👍 😮 😢 🔥) first and any emoji behind the +, and let a double-click heart someone else's message.
Do say "Seen" as text under your newest message, and only between people who both share read receipts.
Do put the peek ("Kenji is here") in the status line above the composer, giving way to reconnecting and typing.
Do leave the name off runs in a one-to-one DM; in a group chat, put the author's avatar beside the last bubble of their run.
donts: Don't use a smooth-scroll library or hijack the wheel.
Don't add a second backdrop blur to a screen; the header owns the only one.
Don't put coloured glow shadows on buttons, cards, panels or frames.
Don't stamp a status pill or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't nest boxes inside the sheet: no card around an empty state, a settings section or a list.
Don't collapse navigation to bare icons, at any width.
Don't break the app into floating boxed panels: one content sheet, not a sidebar box, a centre box and a side box.
Don't use display type for labels, shelf heads or reading text, or at hero sizes inside the app.
Don't build a Discord-style icon rail of Spaces; Spaces are listed by name.
Don't show the current destination, a selected row or a tab in the accent; current is a neutral fill.
Don't pretend a feature works: no fake counts, no fake people, no dates we can't keep. On Home nothing is padded out, and unread is never a number.
Don't clone Instagram, Threads or Discord: take the feel, keep Realm's own frame, type, colour and words.
Don't let a moment or overlay cover the phone's screen, or show the phone's back.
Don't use translucent white fills for tags or chips.
Don't mark a conversation's encryption with a lock, a shield, a warning colour or the word "encrypted" on its own while it isn't end-to-end encrypted.
Don't show read receipts as ticks or faces, or to someone who doesn't share their own.
Don't float the peek, or any presence, over the messages.
Don't put a photo or video on a coloured mat, or a card inside a bubble.
Don't fill a button with Danger or Danger Line.
Don't ship a dead control: no switch, button or menu item for a service that isn't configured.
Don't put anyone's location in a URL, query string or route.
Don't announce whole lists, history or every keystroke through a live region.
Don't put holo foil anywhere but the profile card's edge, or float mascots or stickers loose on the page.
Don't bring back the old world's sky, stars, aurora, amber or Bricolage Grotesque, or use the legacy alias names, in any screen of this world.

Don't use a text size or corner outside the scales above. Built today and not part of the scales (align on next touch): the AuthCard and sign-up preview at 1.75rem (frame is 1.8rem); menu heads at 0.85rem (use Tag, 0.82rem); account and device lines at 0.94rem (use Hint or Body Small); sign-up leads at 1.1–1.15rem (use Lead App); Since Spaces and media: the voice room's title at 1.7rem (use Dialog Title); the Space-not-found and invite-card titles at 2rem; the "can't post here" note at 1.4rem corners (the composer is 1.5rem); the invite card at 1.75rem (frame is 1.8rem); the invite page's action built by hand at 56px with 36px sides instead of `pill("action", "lg")`. Since the Wall frame (2026-10-05): the settings list's title at 1.1rem and its group heads at 0.8rem (use Panel Title and Tag); the chat's Delete confirm at 32px and 0.86rem (use the danger ghost sm); colours written as literals: On Mint `#04150f` on the Presence speaker badges whatever the theme, and the avatar cut rings on Live tiles (`rgb(20 14 14)`), the Live strip (`#15201b`) and the current nav row (`#1a1a1f`). Since Messages (2026-10): the conversation header's title at 1.15rem and 1.3rem, Conversation start's at 1.5rem, the empty pane's at 1.35rem and the missing conversation's at 1.4rem; conversation row titles at 0.98rem; presence lines, picker handles and reaction counts at 0.85rem (use Chat Small); the encryption chip at 0.8rem (use Tag); the phone tab's count at 0.65rem; the group name and rename fields at 44px (fields are 56px); and the current inbox row's avatar cut ring as the literal `#1e1e24`.
